This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]]. [[Mokko]] was a member of the species.<ref name="Retrieval" />

==Biology and appearance==
This large [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their large builds, [[Color|red]] and beige skin, [[Eye|eyes]] with red sclera and yellow irises, large [[ear]]s and chins, and interconnecting hard plating across their foreheads and brows.<ref name="Retrieval" />

==Species in the galaxy==
At some point, a member of this species, [[Mokko]], had taken up residence on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Ipsidon]]. Becoming a [[Mokko's crew|gang]] [[Crime lord|boss]] and establishing [[Mokkotown]], he was eventually dispatched thanks to the efforts of [[Clone Force 99]] and rebelling members of his workforce such as [[Benni Baro]].<ref name="Retrieval" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their debut in the [[Retrieval (episode)|tenth episode]] of the [[The Bad Batch Season 2|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'', written by [[Moisés Zamora]], directed by [[Steward Lee]],<ref name="Retrieval" /> and aired on [[February 22]], [[2023]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
